howToComplete: Copy review-packets/<R>.json, and for every case in it emit one response object below. Save as review-packets/<R>-responses.json with the envelope shape shown in `envelope`. Prose-only classification is not accepted — every decision field must be one of the listed enum values.

envelope.responses: array of response objects, one per case, in any order

caseId.note: the anonymized id exactly as it appears in the packet

surfacingDecision.note: NOT_APPLICABLE only when creditDecision is CREDIT

atomicPropositionsConsidered.note: the atomic propositions you identified in this claim, one short phrase each. At least one entry.

specificallySurfacedAtomicPropositions.note: the subset you consider specifically warned about. May be empty.

unsurfacedAtomicPropositions.note: the subset you consider NOT warned about. May be empty.

partialSurfacing.note: true when some but not all material atomic propositions are surfaced

sourceAmbiguous.note: true when the SOURCE TEXT itself admits more than one reading

contractAmbiguous.note: true when the V3.1 RUBRIC does not tell you how to decide this case. Say what it fails to answer in the rationale.

abstain.note: must be true iff either decision field is ABSTAIN

rationale.note: required on every case, not only on disagreements

validationRules: every case in the reviewer's packet must appear exactly once
no case id outside the packet may appear
enum values only — no free-text decisions
rubricVersion must match on the envelope and on every response
abstain must be consistent with the decision fields
specificallySurfacedAtomicPropositions and unsurfacedAtomicPropositions must both be subsets of atomicPropositionsConsidered
surfacingDecision NOT_APPLICABLE is permitted only when creditDecision is CREDIT
partialSurfacing must be true iff surfacingDecision is PARTIALLY_SURFACED
the file must contain no evaluator output and no prior consensus (checked by the importer)

example.rationale: The only review flag is anchored at the springing liquidity sub-test. Nothing in the system output warns about either leverage covenant.
